To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the THERAFlex MB‐Plasma System was effective in inactivating all four DENV serotypes and CHIKV in a plasma model, as determined by a 4‐log reduction in viral infectivity and by a reduction in viral RNA to below the limit of detection.
the THERAFEX MB‐Plasma System was able to effectively inactivate DENV serotypes 1, 2, 3, and 4 and CHIKV in human plasma.
the THERAFELX MB‐Plasma treatment of plasma with methylene blue is effective in inactivating DENV‐1, ‐2, and ‐4 and CHIKV.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the inactivation of dengue virus and chikungunia virus in human plasma using a novel pathogen inactivation system.

the development and validation of an analytical method for the quantification of dengue and chikingunya viruses in human plasma using real-time PCR and the evaluation of a pathogen inactivation system for the treatment of these viruses.
the development of a novel method for the treatment of blood plasma with methylene blue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

THERAFLEX‐MB plasma treatment is effective against DENV serotypes 1, 2, 3 and 4 and CHIKV, as determined by a combination of plaque reduction neutralization tests and virus titration in cell culture, with no significant residual virus detected.
the THERAFEX MB‐PLASMA system inactivates all tested DENV and CHIKV strains in a dose dependent manner.
the THERAFEX MB‐Plasma pathogen inactivation system is effective in reducing DENV and CHIKV infectivity in human plasma.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
methylene blue and illumination at 630 nm effectively inactivate DENV and CHIKV in human plasma.
methylene blue and 630 nm light effectively inactivated DENV and CHIKV in a range of plasma products.
we have demonstrated that THERAFLEX‐MB Plasma system can inactivate DENV and CHIKV, and is therefore an effective pathogen inactivation method for plasma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the THERAFlex MB‐plasma system can be used for inactivation of dengue and chikingunya viruses in plasma, and the inactivation is effective for all serotypes of dengue viruses.
the THERAFEX MB‐Plasma method is effective in inactivating DENV‐1, ‐2, ‐3, and ‐4, as well as CHIKV in a plasma matrix.
methylene blue and 630 nm light treatment is an effective method of inactivating DENV and CHIKV.
